thread.title: Brokers Set Expectations for Apple Inc.’s Q1 2019 Earnings (AAPL)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Brokers Set Expectations for Apple Inc.’s Q1 2019 Earnings (AAPL)
text: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Equities researchers at Piper Jaffray Companies boosted their Q1 2019 EPS estimates for shares of Apple in a note issued to investors on Monday, October 1st. Piper Jaffray Companies analyst M. Olson now forecasts that the iPhone maker will post earnings of $4.87 per share for the quarter, up from their previous estimate of $4.82. Piper Jaffray Companies currently has a “Overweight” rating and a $250.00 price target on the stock.
